lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank, with approximately five horizontal tiers visible.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form a lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (dorsal) to lower luminance (lateral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two elongated, high-intensity white objects attached to the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface displays a significantly higher density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
